name: roofing-tekline
label: Tekline port — CONTAMINATED, out of service
why_this_file_exists: Until 2026-07-31 this directory had NO BOILERPLATE.json at all. That was not a cosmetic gap. lib/mirror-engine/donor.js readManifest() returns {} for a missing manifest, so resolveDonor({donor:'roofing-tekline'}) answered ok:true, and lib/mirror-engine/scan.js identityScan() built its atom list from manifest fields that did not exist — an EMPTY atom list, which returns clean:true for ANY bytes. Proven at the console: identityScan(index.html, {}) -> {clean:true,hits:[]} while that same index.html hard-codes a third party's postal address. A donor with no manifest is a donor with no identity gate, and it was indistinguishable in the build manifest from a real pass.

retired.reason: Ships a third party's real postal address, real geo coordinates, a hardcoded state and another business's Google Analytics measurement ID, all as hardcoded literals rather than tokens — in a dist whose identity gate could not fire because the manifest was missing.
retired.enforced_by: lib/mirror-engine/donor.js donorRetirement() — resolveDonor now refuses this donor by NAME and by vertical with error donor_retired. Before this file existed there was no door to close.
retired.keep_the_directory: Deliberate. lib/forge.js (the legacy SiteForge lane) still hydrates this dist and test/donor-no-hardcoded-state.test.js pins its bytes. Deleting it breaks that lane; retiring it removes it from the Mirror Engine only.
defects: THIRD-PARTY POSTAL ADDRESS (P0). index.html JSON-LD carries streetAddress 635 Industry Dr as a hardcoded literal, sitting directly beside a correctly tokenised addressLocality and postalCode. Every mirror built from this donor publishes a PostalAddress placing the customer at another company's building.
THIRD-PARTY GEO (P0). The same JSON-LD block hardcodes latitude 47.452588999999996 and longitude -122.248138 — a fixed point in Washington — for every customer regardless of where they trade.

THIRD-PARTY ANALYTICS ID (P0). G-NM0SE1M1T4 is hardcoded in index.html. donors-clean/roofing-falcon-clean/BOILERPLATE.json declares that exact string in its own account_ids as identity to be scrubbed. Falcon was cleaned; this dist was not, so every Tekline mirror reported traffic into a third party's Google Analytics property.

HARDCODED STATE (P1). addressRegion is the literal WA. test/donor-no-hardcoded-state.test.js passes on this file only because its regex looks for comma-space-STATE and this residue is quoted-STATE — a vacuous pass, not a clean donor.

UNGUARDED OPTIONAL SLOT (P1). assets/index-DqHc579c.js welds the literal copy " or email " to an optional EMAIL slot, so a prospect with no verified email hydrates to broken prose. Proven: a real dryRun mirror() of this donor returns 500 unguarded_optional_slot.
unretire_requires: streetAddress, latitude and longitude tokenised or removed — verified by grep over every shipped file, not just index.html.
G-NM0SE1M1T4 absent from every byte of the dist.
addressRegion driven by the state token, with a regex that actually matches quoted-state residue.
The unguarded EMAIL slot guarded, proven by a dryRun mirror() that returns 200 with no email fact supplied.
A rendered DOM on a live URL: 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors, 0 failed requests. A green gate is not evidence.
